summary.name: Adaptify SEO
summary.one_liner: Adaptify SEO is an agency-focused platform that automates keyword and prompt research, content creation and publishing, link building, AI search visibility tracking, and client reporting from one dashboard.
use_cases: automate keyword and prompt research for client accounts
publish AI-written SEO articles to client CMS
automate link building outreach and placements
track brand visibility in AI search engines
send white label SEO reports to clients
consolidate agency SEO tools into one platform
summary.what_it_does: The page describes a platform covering keyword and prompt research, competitor analysis, and keyword gap discovery. It generates AI articles intended to match search intent and cite sources, and can publish them directly to a client's CMS. It handles link prospecting, outreach, and placement on indexed pages, and tracks AI visibility across major AI platforms. It also offers white label reporting with branded PDFs, live dashboards, and AI-written email summaries, plus a proposal builder.
notable: Single dashboard replacing keyword, content, link building, reporting and proposal tools
AI visibility (GEO) tracking that turns prompts into published content
White label client portal with branded PDF reports
Integrates with tools clients already use (named on page only as a logo section)
caveats: Pricing is not stated on the page; a demo is offered instead
Headline metrics such as hours saved and margin gains are vendor claims and not independently verified
Aimed at agencies; the page does not describe use for individual or in-house teams
